slides.headline: WHEN SOMEONE OWES YOU MONEY, THESE 6 FREE AI PROMPTS GET IT BACK.
slides.image_prompt: Faceless figure raises crimson rubber stamp overhead over dark desk with papers, triumph, Claude logo glows on charcoal wall. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, crimson accent.

slides.headline: 1) WRITE A FINAL NOTICE THAT SOUNDS LIKE A LAW FIRM SENT IT
slides.body: A business attorney charges between $200 and $500 for this. This prompt does it free: "$[amount] for [service], [X] days overdue. Write a firm final notice implying legal action if unpaid. No false threats."

slides.headline: 2) SEND THE FIRST NUDGE THAT DOESN'T RUIN THE RELATIONSHIP
slides.body: Most late invoices were forgotten, not ignored. A warm first reminder at 30 days overdue recovers the majority: "$[amount] for [service] is 30 days overdue. Write a short warm reminder. Assume they forgot."

slides.headline: 3) NEGOTIATE A PAYMENT PLAN IN ONE EMAIL
slides.body:
A structured plan beats a dispute when a client can't pay in full:

"[Client] owes $[amount] for [service]. Propose a 3-installment plan with specific dates. Make it easy to say yes to."

slides.headline: 4) ASK FOR A DEPOSIT BEFORE YOU START ANYTHING
slides.body: A $5,000 project with no deposit means pure trust. If the client disappears, you recover nothing: "[Project] at $[total]. Write a confident message requesting a 50% deposit before I start. Make it feel standard."

slides.headline: 5) ADD A LATE PAYMENT CLAUSE TO ANY CONTRACT IN 30 SECONDS
slides.body:
Most service businesses skip the late payment clause. Claude adds it to anything you paste:

"[Your terms]. Add a clause: 1.5% monthly interest on overdue balances, work pauses after 30 days."

slides.headline: 6) FOLLOW UP ON A QUOTE THAT WENT COMPLETELY SILENT
slides.body:
An unanswered quote is money on the table. This prompt reopens the conversation without begging:

"I quoted $[amount] for [service] [X] days ago, no reply. Write a confident follow-up that leaves the door open."
slides.image_prompt: A laptop open to an email thread, a single message with a bold red exclamation symbol showing zero replies, a dead phone lying face-down beside the keyboard. No text readable. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash. Accent: muted teal against off-white.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR NEXT TIME THEY DON'T PAY
slides.body: You'll want these when it happens. And it will happen. Daily AI news and real skills, every day

caption:
Swipe through these before your next invoice goes unpaid. Six AI prompts that collect what clients owe you, no lawyer or phone call needed. 💼

Final notice that sounds like a law firm wrote it, first gentle nudge at 30 days that doesn't burn the relationship, payment plan negotiation in one email, deposit request that feels like standard practice, late payment clause for any contract, follow-up on a quote that went silent. Six prompts, copy and paste, use tonight.

Bloomberg reported this week that 60% of Gen-Z and millennials moved back home in the past two years. When consumers are tight, clients pay late. The business owners who handle collections with AI stop losing hours to follow-up calls.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Bloomberg, Anthropic
